implementation_notes: Cache hits currently still resolve/fetch the fixed remote selection; cache_hit refers to reused verified export bytes and does not imply offline acquisition.
Approval format 1 gains optional Git provenance binding; existing local approval JSON stays unchanged. All management writers verify this binding before preserving Git identity.

Management errors retain existing text output: management-input-changed identifies stale captured inputs; existing lock and joined rollback error text is retained rather than claiming the future update/frozen schema.
Shared management guard covers commit and rollback only. Network, confirmation and post-commit state cleanup are outside the guard.
App coordinates candidates, captured inputs, package exchange and guard; agenthooks retains codecs, renderer/owner/trust merging and ApplyFiles. Only renderer input path enumeration was added.
limits: Public HTTPS and normal system TLS trust only; no SSH/file/private credentials/proxy CLI override.
Export has limits, not a remote pack download byte cap.
Guard coordinates same-version cooperating management processes; it is not authentication against the same user or a power-loss atomic multi-file transaction.
A3 local OS/built-hook fixtures do not close real harness/native loading/delivery, B1/C1/B2/C2, Windows or CI.
